description: Send one question to Jev several times, as written and with its layout changed, options reversed, labels hidden, levels reversed, criteria removed, to see whether the answer holds. Returns a report as Markdown with a verdict and which variants moved the decision. The text must carry the state the question is asked against, and when it has more than one question, questionId names the one. Asks Jev only, about a dozen requests, with the user's TypeSafe key found the way ask_model finds it. It costs money, so call it only when the user asks to probe a question.

filename.description: A file name whose extension says what the text is: .json, .ts, .js, .py, .rs or .go. Defaults to request.jev.json.

model.description: A Jev version. Defaults to jev-1.13.0.

questionId.description: The id of the question to probe. Needed when the text has more than one.

text.description: The request JSON or the source code.

name: probe_question

keySource.description: Where the API key was found: the environment, .env.local or .env. Never the key.

moved.description: The variants that changed the decision. Empty when the answer held.

requests.description: Requests sent: three as written, then one per layout change.

verdict.description: The one sentence the report opens with.

title: Probe a question
